NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
5828 - 32 North Broadway
From B1-2 to B2-3

The Property
The subject property is vacant. The surrounding area is comprised of varying zoning districts, including B1-1, B1-
2, B1-3, B3-2, RM-3.5, RM-5, and RM-6 districts. The area is improved with buildings with a range of heights
ranging from one-story to more than 20-stories and comprised of residential, commercial, and industrial uses. The
property is also a Transit Served Location per the Transit Oriented Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
Section 17-10-0102-B (1), as it is within 831 feet of the CTA Thorndale Avenue Red Line Train Station entrance;
and fronts Broadway along the Broadway #36 Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment.*

The Project
The Applicant proposes to construct a five-story mixed-use building with a 1,443 square-foot ground-floor

commercial space and eighteen residential dwelling units above the ground floor. Nine accessory automobile
parking spaces and twenty bicycle parking spaces will be provided. The zoning height of the building will be
sixty-seven feet and one-half inch. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a zoning change for
the subject property from a B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District to a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
As part of the Type 1 rezoning application the Applicant seeks a variation under Sections 17-13-0303-D and 17-
13-1101-B to reduce the rear yard setback from the required 30 feet to 20 feet.

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements
1, The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location within 831 feet of the CTA Thorndale Avenue Red Line Train Station entrance; and fronts
Broadway along the Broadway #36 Bus Line Corridor Roadway Segment. The proposed development
does not include more than 50% of the otherwise required parking.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is not adjacent to a pedestrian street but complies with Section 17-3-0504 as a

new construction within 2,640 feet of a CTA rail station entrance because:

e Building Location: The front fagade faces North Broadway, and the design complies with sections
(1) and (2)(a)-(c), as the setbacks are no more than 5 feet, and the entrance size is within the required
parameters;

° Transparency: The Applicant will provide an adequate amount of transparent fagade;

© Doors and Entrances: The building’s front doors will face North Broadway, and will be set back no
more than 3.5 feet;

° Off-Street Parking: 9 on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

e Parking Location: On-site parking will be enclosed and located in the rear; and

° Driveways and Vehicle Access: The Applicant will provide access to the parking garage from the
rear alley.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide: Station Area
Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan
Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is identified under the Transit Friendly Guide station topography as Dense
Urban Neighborhood, which provides that developments have increased density, height, and pedestrian
and bicycle connections to transit.

* A set of plans, including a site plan showing the TSL distances to CTA Rail Station is attached.

4. Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The project does not have parking in excess of 50%. The Applicant is providing 9 off-street
automobile parking spaces.

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department

of Transportation.
RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan

rules promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 6,750 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 23,751 sq. ft.

FAR: 3.52**

Residential Dwelling Units: 18

MLA Density: 375 sq. ft.**

Height: 65.5 ft.***

Automobile Parking: 9

Bicycle Parking: 20

Setbacks:
Front (N. Broadway) 0°
South 9"
West (Alley) 20°
North 3' 6"

** The project will comply with Section 17-3-0308 and contain 100% on-site ARO units, and thus qualifies for
an MLA Reduction under 17-3-0402-B and a FAR increase under 17-3-0403-B.

*** The proposed ground floor commercial space complies with sections 17-3-0305 and 17-3-0305-A and
qualifies for a seventy-five-foot zoning height under 17-3-0408-B.
